sections.title: Landscape vocabulary
sections.content:
Rich vocabulary for describing natural settings:
• picturesque — visually attractive, like a painting. The village was absolutely picturesque in autumn.
• breathtaking — astonishingly beautiful. The view from the mountain top was breathtaking.
• barren — too poor to produce vegetation. The barren desert stretched for hundreds of miles.
• lush — rich and abundant vegetation. The tropical rainforest was incredibly lush and green.
• rugged — having a rough, uneven surface. The rugged coastline attracts adventurous hikers.

sections.title: Urban descriptions
sections.content:
Describing cities and built environments:
• bustling — full of energetic activity. The bustling market was filled with traders and shoppers.
• run-down — in poor condition from neglect. The run-down neighbourhood is being regenerated.
• vibrant — full of energy and life. The city has a vibrant arts and music scene.
• sprawling — spreading over a wide area. The sprawling suburbs extend far beyond the city centre.
• quaint — attractively old-fashioned. We stayed in a quaint little cottage by the river.

exercises.question: Scenery so beautiful it takes your breath away is:
exercises.explanation: Breathtaking means astonishing or awe-inspiring in quality.

exercises.question: Land with no vegetation or life is:
exercises.explanation: Barren means too poor to produce much vegetation; unproductive.

exercises.question: A place full of busy activity and energy is:
exercises.explanation: Bustling means full of energetic and noisy activity.

exercises.question: An area with rich, abundant green vegetation is:
exercises.explanation: Lush means growing luxuriantly; rich and abundant in vegetation.

exercises.question: A building in poor condition from lack of care is:
exercises.explanation: Run-down means in a poor state of repair due to neglect.

exercises.question: A city that spreads over a wide area is:
exercises.explanation: Sprawling means spreading out over a large area in an untidy way.

exercises.question: A place full of life, colour, and excitement is:
exercises.explanation: Vibrant means full of energy and life.
